changelog:
Version 0.6.66 (stability and security):
- Fix crash: a malformed Content-Length on the local port could terminate OBS
- Fix crash: an unresolved image encoder handed GDI+ an uninitialized CLSID on every frame
- Fix corruption: model names with accents or non-ASCII characters broke frame paths
- Fix data races between the capture, server and UI threads (session data and settings)
- Harden the local server: loopback-only, request limits, timeouts and path validation
- Remove the shell from the FFmpeg pipeline and sanitize output file names
- Stronger uninstall: closes OBS and fully removes the plugin so it no longer keeps running after removal
